paragraphs: Biarri Networks sells fiber network planning and design, producing construction-ready designs for network operators and engineering teams. The company says its designs arrive up to 25 times faster than traditional methods. Cost estimates and planning insights are aimed at Tier 2 and Tier 3 service providers preparing bids.

The platform is GIS-based and fits its designs into systems and workflows a customer already runs. Plans can be tailored to a customer's own rules, architectures, and deployment environment. Teams can weigh deployment options such as underground against aerial. GIS data can be exported in formats including TAB, SHP, GEOJSON, and KML. Demand forecasting is offered for rural and low-density areas, where operators must justify the build. A standalone software-as-a-service product called FOND Planner lets customers design their own network plans.

The company was founded in Australia to change a traditional and time-consuming planning and design process. Its team now spans Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam, the UK, and the United States, and the Denver office serves as its American headquarters. Its information security management system is certified to ISO/IEC 27001. The company takes part in the Fiber Broadband Association and INCA.

quote.text: Founded in Australia with a mission to disrupt the traditional, time-consuming process of network planning and design
